request.query: Rational real center has finitely many rational approximations abs(a-q) < 1/q.den^2

items.name: Rat.den_le_and_le_num_le_of_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
items.type: ∀ {ξ q : ℚ}, |ξ - q| < 1 / ↑q.den ^ 2 → q.den ≤ ξ.den ∧ ⌈ξ * ↑q.den⌉ - 1 ≤ q.num ∧ q.num ≤ ⌊ξ * ↑q.den⌋ + 1

items.name: Real.exists_rat_eq_convergent
items.type: ∀ {ξ : ℝ} {q : ℚ}, |ξ - ↑q| < 1 / (2 * ↑q.den ^ 2) → ∃ n, q = ξ.convergent n
